optSubtitle.message: AI summaries over the long paragraphs of any website.

optWelcomeStep1.message: Pick an AI provider below. The **on-device AI** needs no account or connection.

optWelcomeStep2.message: Open an article and enable the extension for that site from the toolbar icon.

optWelcomeStep3.message: Click the floating **Summarize** tab on the right edge.

optMinWordsHint.message: Paragraphs below it are grouped with their neighbours until they reach it. Default: 100.

optModeAuto.message: Automatic (in place, reader view if it fails)

optRatioHint.message: Proportion of the original, with a minimum of 15 and a maximum of 100 words. If the summary exceeds 60% of the original text, that block gets no overlay.

optLangAuto.message: Automatic (Spanish if it is a preferred language)

optFallbackHint.message: Used if the primary one fails after retries.

optCloudConsent.message: I accept that the **text of the pages I read is sent** to the cloud AI provider I configure. Without this, only the browser’s on-device AI works.

optGeminiConsent.message: I understand that on the **Google Gemini free tier**, Google **uses the submitted content to train and improve its products**. Since that content is what I am reading, I explicitly accept this condition.

optStrategyHint.message: The on-device AI always uses one call per block: its context window cannot take the whole article.

optBatchSizeHint.message: Empty = all in a single call (default on the Gemini free tier). A value like 8 restores progressive rendering at the cost of more requests.

optDebugLogging.message: **Verbose console logging** — traces extraction, providers and HTTP calls. Warnings and errors are always logged. Page console for the content script; `about:debugging` (Firefox) or `chrome://extensions` (Chrome) for the background.

optSitesHint.message: Sites are enabled from the toolbar icon. Removing them here also revokes the matching host permission.

optConnectOpenrouter.message: Connect with OpenRouter (no key to copy)

keyHintGeminiFree.message: Create a free key in Google AI Studio

keyHintGeminiFreeNote.message: No credit card. ~1,000 articles a day with one call per article.

keyHintOpenrouter.message: OpenRouter key (or use the Connect button)
